sources.title: litert-community/Qwen2-VL-2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2-VL is Alibaba's widely-used general-purpose vision-language model: a dynamic-resolution ViT vision encoder feeds the Qwen2-1.5B language decoder, giving strong general VQA, description, and document/OCR reading in a phone-sized package. This bundle runs the whole thing through LiteRT-LM's fast_vlm multimodal path — give it an image and a question, get a grounded answer, fully on-device.
